subject: cult-info-b
title: CULT.INFO.B.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-29 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One), first of two on book p141, paired with v2-p141-2. Accompanies Braxton's developing concept of unification: 'the concept of unification has to do with an expanded awareness of what is happening on this planet — in this experience (life) — during this particular time period.' (C)CULT-INFO-B (the concept of culture-information basis) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics): the question is what culture-information-basis produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics. TRS (transition) and RT-OP (reality options) form the upper-right output. EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), branching from the TRS line, anchors the right margin and carries RT-OP and TF-SH. PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) hangs from the PHY-U-P line at the lower left. PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars) anchors the lower-left. SOC-RT-DY itself sits centrally. TF-SH (transfer shift) hangs on the lower-right. (D)PART (the dynamics of participation) hangs from the main line on the lower left; PHY-U-P branches from its line, and a *dashed* line runs from it to INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis).
